cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: There's something behind a building near here you might want to look at. Men keep coming round, saying they're British Gas. One of my regulars told me.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: They don't look at the meter. Just the ground at the back. Last time one asked where the cellar was, after telling her he'd checked it the week before.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: She challenged him about that. He wanted to know if she lived on her own. She shut the door.
Hakim sends a pin for the rear of the building. No name accompanies it.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: You can get there from the service lane. Please don't knock on any doors asking who spoke to me. She's worried enough.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: I don't know what they've found. Or if they've found anything. But if you go, be careful.
You save the location. Hakim sends nothing that identifies the woman.
